description: The per-source replay window (RFC 0001 Amendment 23, decision SR-20). Every receiver keeps, per source node, the highest nonce counter (epoch * 65536 + seq) of an authenticated packet and a bitmap of the 64 counters up to it. A counter above the highest is fresh and moves the window; one inside the window (0..63 below the highest) is fresh once and a duplicate after; one 64 or more below is too old. A source's first packet is always fresh. The C core (core/src/replay.c, tested through core/tests/replay_vectors.h), the Python port (simulator/atalaia_sim/replay.py) and the Dart port (app/lib/radio/replay.dart) must give exactly these verdicts, each case starting from an empty window. 'steps' are [epoch, seq, verdict] in arrival order; verdict is fresh, duplicate or too_old.
